what: A mascot handle and a promo card are open at the bottom right of the screen. When the area below the reference section (Hero) exceeds half the screen, or after scrolling more than 1000px (500px on phones) since opening, the card folds right by its own width in .5s, leaving only the handle. Pressing the handle reopens it in .6s and measuring restarts from there. Hovering shifts the handle 10px to signal ”clickable”

options.after: Reference section selector — folds when more than half the screen is below it, unfolds again when scrolled back up. If none, uses scroll distance only
options.away: Folds after scrolling this much (px) past opening, default 1000
options.away-phone: away value at widths of 768px or below, if none then away
options.--fx-nudge: Handle shift on hover (via style), default 10px
options.[data-fx-part=handle]: Pressed handle (child) — expanded state via aria-expanded
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Card (child) that moves off screen when folded — shifts aside by this width

use: Promo Card
note: The original expands after load and measures with ScrollTrigger (start: bottom 50%, end: max) — the part measures the same boundary with a scroll listener

from.where: index.html .hb (bottom-right mascot + 3:1 promo banner) · index.js — original .homebanner, desktop 1000px · phone 500px
